expected_symptom: Orientation qualifier requested on a template-dependent matrix is not present in the emitted DXIL, while the identical non-template declaration honours it.
summary: Matrix orientation never reaches a template-dependent matrix type. #pragma pack_matrix(row_major) on a matrix<T,X,Y> member is silently dropped -- the row_major, column_major and no-pragma builds are byte-identical, while the same three without the template differ -- and an explicitly written row_major on such a member is instead rejected with 'can only be used with a matrix type' at template definition time, which is the issue's own test case. Both faces come from testing matrix-ness on a still-dependent type (SemaType.cpp:4359 skips, SemaType.cpp:5820 rejects). -Zpr does work on template-dependent members, because it takes the codegen-default route rather than annotating the type. Reproduces on all 16 stable releases that can compile HLSL 2021 templates, from v1.6.2112 to main.
title: `column_major` and `row_major` don't apply correctly to template-dependent types
